ext.title: LikeC4
ext.cmd.print-dot-of-currentview: Print DOT of current view to output
ext.config.node.path.title: Node.js binary path
ext.config.cli.path.description:
Path to the LikeC4 CLI used by **Copy as PNG** and **Save as PNG** (e.g. `node_modules/likec4/bin/likec4.mjs` or a global `likec4` executable). Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder.  
If empty, the extension resolves the `likec4` package installed in the project (Yarn PnP: `yarn likec4`). `.js`/`.mjs` entries run with `#likec4.node.path#`.
ext.config.export.notation.enabled.descr: Include the view notation (legend) in images from **Copy as PNG** and **Save as PNG**. It lists the element kinds of the view that have a `notation` in the specification.
ext.config.export.notation.position.desc:
Corner of the image for the notation, when `#likec4.export.notation.enabled#` is on. The notation is placed beside the diagram and never covers it.  
Older LikeC4 CLIs (1.61.0 and earlier) ignore this setting.
ext.config.export.notation.text.descript:
Labels of the notation entries, when `#likec4.export.notation.enabled#` is on.  
Older LikeC4 CLIs (1.61.0 and earlier) ignore this setting.
ext.config.export.notation.text.short: Text before the first `:` of the notation (the whole text if there is none)
